say:1:1732286001:1.text: House Augusta, of course! We're the rightful rulers of the Lightbearer Empire!
say:1:1732286001:1.source_cn: 当然是给我们奥古斯塔家族！毕竟奥古斯塔才是耀光帝国真正...

say:2:1732286002:1.text: If she truly has no desire for the throne, she should establish a council led by House Augusta as soon as possible!
say:2:1732286002:1.source_cn: 如果她真有心放权，那么首先她应该尽快设立以奥古斯塔家族...

say:3:1732286003:1.text: She shouldn't be deciding Savannah's fate all on her own!
say:3:1732286003:1.source_cn: 整个赛凡纳不能再是她一个人说了算！
